description: This source file defines a health check class for an ASP.NET Core web application. The class HomePageHealthCheck implements IHealthCheck to verify the health status of the home page by making an HTTP GET request and checking for specific content in the response.

classes.name: HomePageHealthCheck
classes.description: A health check class that verifies the homepage content contains a specific string to determine overall health status.

methods.name: CheckHealthAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous health check by sending a GET request to the homepage URL and searching for a specific string in the page content to determine health status.
